spans.s: --a medicinal plant capable of restoring the dead to life; found in द्रोण hill of शाल्मलिद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ३९.

--the science of restoring the dead back to life; learnt from महेश्वर; discovered by शुक्र (ब्र्। प्।) and learnt by भृगु; practised by शुक्र for the [page२-726+ २६] benefit of the Asuras in the देवासुर war;
1: Br. III. ३०. ५३; M. २४९. 4-6.
जामदग्नि restored to life with that.
2: Br. III. ३०. ५८.
--death-pollution for १० days for Brah- manas, १२ for क्षत्रियस्, १५ for वैश्यस् and one month for शुद्रस्. वा. ७९. २२-3.
--a R. धेनुका of the साकद्वीप. वा. ४९. ९४.

(VI)--the son of माया and Bhaya: father of व्याधि, जरा, शोक, Krodha, and असूय; all giving pain and having the characteristics of adharma and having no wives or sons; belong to the तामस sarga. Br.
